note: Canonical Region + Tissue values. Agents MUST choose region/tissue from these exact tokens. Structure leaf is free PascalCase_with_underscores. Final governed tag = SnapOrtho::Anatomy::<Region>::<Tissue>::<Structure>.

regions.desc: Bone/cartilage/tissue science, physis, growth, general osteology concepts not tied to one body region.
Vertebral column, spinal cord, nerve roots, disc, sacrum-as-spine.
Clavicle, scapula, glenoid, proximal humerus articular, rotator cuff, AC/SC joints.
Humeral shaft and diaphysis, brachium soft tissue (non-articular).
Elbow joint, distal humerus, capitellum, trochlea, olecranon, coronoid, elbow ligaments, distal biceps.
Radius, ulna shafts, interosseous membrane, DRUJ, PIN/AIN, Henry approach structures.
Wrist, carpals, metacarpals, phalanges, pulleys, TFCC, carpal tunnel, digital nerves/arteries.
Pelvic ring, acetabulum, sacrum-as-pelvis, pubic symphysis, iliac wing.
Femur proximal/head/neck/trochanters/shaft, hip joint/capsule, gluteals, sciatic/femoral nerve, femoral vessels.
Tibia, fibula, patella, menisci, cruciates, knee collaterals, leg compartments, popliteal/peroneal structures.
Talus, calcaneus, malleoli, syndesmosis, ankle ligaments, Lisfranc, subtalar, midfoot, Achilles.
Truly pan-regional/systemic with no single home. Use sparingly.

tissues.desc: Whole bones and named bony regions/landmarks (e.g. Femoral_Head, Greater_Trochanter, Tibial_Plateau, Physis, Calcar, Surgical_Neck).
Articulations, joint capsules, syndesmoses (e.g. Hip_Joint, Elbow_Joint, DRUJ, Subtalar_Joint, MCP/PIP/DIP/CMC, Pubic_Symphysis, AC/SC).
Ligaments and labrum-like stabilizers (e.g. ACL/PCL, collaterals, scapholunate, deltoid ligament, volar plate, Lisfranc ligament).
Muscles and muscle groups (e.g. Supraspinatus, Subscapularis, Rotator_Cuff, Gluteus_Medius, APB, short external rotators).
Named tendons and tendon systems (e.g. Achilles_Tendon, Patellar_Tendon, Quadriceps_Tendon, Distal_Biceps_Tendon, pulleys, flexor pulley system).
Peripheral nerves and branches, spinal cord (e.g. Radial/Median/Ulnar/Sciatic/Femoral, AIN, PIN, digital nerves).
Arteries, veins, vascular arches, named blood supply (e.g. Popliteal/Radial/Brachial artery, MFCA, superficial palmar arch).
Fascial compartments (e.g. Anterior/Lateral/Deep_Posterior compartment of the leg).
Surgical intervals, tunnels/spaces, membranes, hubs, zones not fitting a tissue (e.g. Carpal_Tunnel, Henry_Interval, Interosseous_Membrane, Extensor_Tendon_Zones).
